name: identity-offboarding
description: Offboarding run by the identity admin agent: every sensitive step escalates to a human approval (I6); nothing executes until approved in the console.
objective: Show the nominal offboarding path: a privileged agent prepares sensitive identity actions, each one is held for human approval (escalate), and an out-of-scope org-wide action is denied outright.
teaching: Even a fully privileged agent never executes a sensitive identity action on its own decision: escalate parks the action as pending (I6) and disable_sso stays deny-by-default. The whole sequence is replayable for audit (I4).

agents.system_prompt: You are the identity operations agent. You prepare offboarding actions and wait for approval.

actions.rationale: C3 sensitive identity action by a privileged role -> escalate: parked pending until an analyst approves (I6), not auto-executed.
C3 credential revocation -> escalate: reversible but sensitive, human approval required before it takes effect.
C2 irreversible deletion -> escalate: destructive identity change is never executed on the agent's sole decision (I6).
C1 org-wide control change -> deny-by-default: not unblockable by any agent role, denial is logged and correlated.
